evals.prompt: Find relevant resource-page opportunities for a bicycle repair guide in Britain.
evals.expected_output: Qualify exact audience fit and official page evidence; do not reuse SaaS directories by default.

evals.prompt: The publisher said yes. Mark the backlink completed.
evals.expected_output: Require retained capture, matching anchor and destination; keep reply separate from placement.

evals.prompt: Prepare a free company listing for a museum archive; the catalogue promises dofollow.
evals.expected_output: Check actual listing eligibility, cost/renewal and link inclusion; dofollow remains unverified.

evals.prompt: The resource URL returns 403. Draft a broken-link replacement claim.
evals.expected_output: Treat access-limited as unknown; do not assert a broken resource.

evals.prompt: Verify this known reference URL; do not research new keywords.
evals.expected_output: Use verification mode with known source/target and no unnecessary page-planning work.

evals.prompt: Send every directory the generated pitch.
evals.expected_output: Prepare only scoped packets; no mass sender exists or authorization follows from discovery.
